user_review.method: Maintainer review from public description and isolated synthetic fixtures or explicitly simulated instruction walkthroughs. Not independent review, external user research, or production usage.

scenarios.request: Recap test-backed refactor, untested limiter and two proposed migrations.
scenarios.observed: Simulated output: auth refactor verified by visible test output; limiter behavior unverified; migration undecided. New table supplies all evidence needed; no invented test count.

scenarios.request: Ask for 3 rounds when only 2 user exchanges plus tool notices are visible.
scenarios.expected: Say only two exchanges exist and exclude tool notices.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough recaps two, states the limit, adds no invented third round or unsupported insight. No file writes in the simulated response.

similar_skills.reason: Retain selected task identity and milestone updates; no need to import engine hooks or fixed action counters.

similar_skills.learned: A compact handoff names goal, state, validation and next actions and references existing artifacts.
similar_skills.reason: Use explicit evidence and next action; temporary storage and AI handoff scope are not appropriate for every workflow.
